seo.h1: Are Hardee's Biscuits Really Made From Scratch?

question: Are Hardee's Biscuits Really Made From Scratch?
quick_answer: Yes. Hardee's Made from Scratch biscuits are mixed, rolled and cut by hand in each restaurant every morning. Biscuit bakers arrive around 4 a.m., make the dough with real buttermilk, and bake a fresh batch about every 15 minutes during breakfast. A plain biscuit costs about $1.75, and biscuit breakfasts are a big part of Hardee's business.
key_facts: Made by hand in each restaurant every morning
Made with real buttermilk, rolled and cut by hand
A fresh batch about every 15 minutes during breakfast
On the menu since the late 1970s

body.heading: How Hardee's makes its biscuits
body.text: Every Hardee's has trained biscuit bakers who come in before the restaurant opens, around 4 a.m. They mix the dough with real buttermilk, then roll it out and cut each biscuit by hand. Biscuits go into the oven in batches about every 15 minutes, so there are warm ones throughout the breakfast rush. A busy baker can make eight to twelve batches of dough in a morning.

body.heading: Why they're different from most fast-food biscuits
body.text: Many fast-food chains use frozen or premade biscuit dough. Hardee's is one of the few big chains, along with places like Bojangles and Chick-fil-A, that still makes biscuits by hand in each restaurant. The result is a taller, flakier biscuit, and it is the base of Hardee's whole breakfast menu.

body.heading: A little history
body.text: Hardee's added Made from Scratch biscuits in the 1970s, and they went nationwide around 1977. The company has said its biscuits helped start the push for better-quality fast-food breakfasts. Biscuits became so important that, around 2020, they made up roughly a third of Hardee's sales. Every year, Hardee's holds a National Biscuit Baker Competition to crown its best baker.

body.heading: Popular Hardee's biscuit orders
body.text: The biscuit comes plain or as a sandwich with sausage, bacon, ham, chicken or eggs and cheese. Fans also like biscuits and gravy, the Loaded Omelet Biscuit with sausage, bacon, ham and cheese, and seasonal versions, like heart-shaped biscuits around Valentine's Day. A plain Made from Scratch biscuit costs about $1.75 at many locations. See our Hardee's menu page for full breakfast prices.

body.heading: Can you get them at Carl's Jr.?
body.text: Sometimes. Carl's Jr., Hardee's sister chain, started serving Hardee's Made from Scratch biscuits at hundreds of Southern California restaurants in 2011. They are still much more central to the menu at Hardee's.
